title: Paul and Virginia
author: Bernardin de Saint-Pierre
description: "Paul and Virginia" by Bernardin de Saint-Pierre is a novel published in 1788.
longDescription: Set on the island of Mauritius under French rule, it tells the story of two friends raised together from birth who fall in love.

authorInfo.bio: Bernardin de Saint-Pierre (1737–1814) wrote Paul and Virginia. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
